sources.role: same upstream PUAE core mapper and firmware source
shared PUAE boundary; no duplicate writer

paths.path: ~/.config/retroarch/retroarch.cfg (or $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/retroarch/retroarch.cfg); native launch injects a private save-directory override.
paths.naming: RetroArch key = value syntax; PUAE custom layers are puae_libretro_<MODEL>.uae, puae_libretro_global.uae and <content-basename>.uae in the effective save directory.

paths.path: RetroArch per-port input_playerN_* bindings plus PUAE's six frontend ports; Lunchbox's native launch resolves and guards model-specific PUAE mappings.
paths.naming: PUAE mapper selects ordinary joystick, CD32/CD32FR gamepad, or mouse semantics from core options; host autoconfig remains frontend-owned; no native launch integration under this identity.

paths.path: ~/.config/retroarch/saves/ when explicitly resolved by RetroArch settings; otherwise the effective content directory.
paths.naming: <content-basename>.srm and core/content-sorted sidecars; PUAE custom .uae layers share the effective save directory.

paths.path: ~/.config/retroarch/states/ when explicitly resolved; otherwise the effective content directory.
paths.naming: <content-basename>.state, .stateN, .state.auto and optional .entry forms; savestate slots are frontend-owned.

PUAE puae_libretro.info firmware paths include machine-dependent Kickstart files such as kick34005.A500, kick40068.A1200, kick40060.CD32 and kick40060.CD32.ext; requiredness and MD5 notes are core-declared.

paths.path: No cryptographic key file is used by the PUAE core contract.
